answer: A echo of per-task receipts records who did what, and the prism of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
